g.title: Entity Relationship Diagram created by erdantic

a.xlink:title:
hydromodpy.core.config_kit.persistence.PersistenceConfig
Orthogonal switch governing every persistence sink.
Toggles are independent: disabling ``save_zarr`` does not silence the catalog, and vice versa. ``save_catalog`` is the master switch for the project DuckDB; when False, every write through :class:`SimulationCatalog` becomes a no-op.

hydromodpy.simulation.planning.config.MeshProcessConfig
``[[simulation.process]]`` entry for a mesh orchestration process.

hydromodpy.simulation.planning.config.SimulationTimeConfig
Canonical simulation time window and forcing-coverage policy.

hydromodpy.simulation.planning.results_config.ResultsConfig
Configuration for ``[simulation.results]``.
Controls whether simulation outputs are stored in the SimulationCatalog, which derived variables are computed, and which export formats are produced automatically after each run.

hydromodpy.simulation.planning.results_config.DerivedConfig
Toggle flags for derived variable computation.

hydromodpy.simulation.planning.results_config.ExportVariablesConfig
Which variables to include in automated exports.
